title.en: Still racing as Canadian Tire Motorsport Park
title.uk: Досі діє як Canadian Tire Motorsport Park

text.en: Mosport's last Formula 1 Canadian Grand Prix was in 1977, won by Jody Scheckter, and the race moved to Montreal in 1978. The track has kept racing since. After a receivership in 1966 it was bought by Cantrack Motor Racing, led by Harvey M. Hudes until his death in 1996, and in 1997-1998 it passed through International Motorsports Group and Panoz Motorsports. Canadian Motorsport Ventures bought it in 2011, and in 2012 a long-term partnership gave it the name Canadian Tire Motorsport Park. The circuit's own history lists events such as NASCAR Pinty's racing, a vintage Grand Prix, an IMSA sports-car round and superbike meetings. On 11 December 2025 a new ownership group led by Peter Thomson was announced, with the existing management staying in place and scheduled activities continuing.
text.uk: Останнє Гран-прі Канади Формули 1 на Mosport відбулося в 1977 році, його виграв Джоді Шектер, а в 1978 році гонка переїхала до Монреаля. Відтоді траса не припиняла працювати. Після процедури банкрутства в 1966 році її купила компанія Cantrack Motor Racing, яку до своєї смерті в 1996 році очолював Гарві М. Г'юдс, а в 1997-1998 роках вона переходила до International Motorsports Group і Panoz Motorsports. Canadian Motorsport Ventures придбала її в 2011 році, а в 2012 році довгострокове партнерство дало їй назву Canadian Tire Motorsport Park. В історії самої траси згадано такі події, як гонки NASCAR Pinty's, ретро-Гран-прі, етап IMSA для спортивних авто та змагання супербайків. 11 грудня 2025 року оголосили про нову групу власників на чолі з Пітером Томсоном: чинне керівництво залишається, а заплановані заходи тривають.

limitations: The circuit's history page shows content only to 2020 (footer 2019); the event list and the 1997-2012 ownership chain come from it. The post-2025 'roadmap' that the owners said would be presented in February 2026 was not found.
The December 2025 announcement does not name the seller; one search result named Canadian Motorsports Ventures, but that was not in an opened page and was not used.
No source for named corners other than the Moss Corner already in existing prose was opened; turns left without names are those without a name in an opened source.
Existing prose on the 1973 race (pace car, Revson win) was not rechecked in this session beyond F1DB; the 1961 opening matches the circuit history ('opened for racing in May 1961').
